note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative (generic clause lines and liability categories, never real contract text). 'Category included' and 'exclusion to be reviewed' are supplied statuses of equal weight (● and ◆ alike). Relations are drawn only as supplied (each category's clause line), as plain lines without arrows. No doctrine on limitation or exclusion clauses: no enforceability, validity or effect, no cap or amount, no outcome. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): schedules, definitions, priorities, relationships/relationLabels (the only relation is each category's supplied clause line), elements (the layer labels are the layerLabels field).
